core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nuria is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Luminous”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nuria corresponds to the Arabic form نُورِيَة (Arabic نُورِيَة (Nūriyya) 'luminous'). Its core sense is nuria; luminous, of light. Nuria is Arabic نُورِيَة (Nūriyya) 'luminous, of light', from نُور (nūr) 'light'. The source gloss 'Light' is broadly consistent. Same name as nouria.
